source_documents.title: Excited-State Intramolecular Proton Transfer (ESIPT) Emission of Hydroxyphenylimidazopyridine: Computational Study on Enhanced and Polymorph-Dependent Luminescence in the Solid State

reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Table 1, visually inspected; solution and solid environments.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Cyclohexane: 578 nm, Phi 0.04, 0.73 ns; BG crystal: 496 nm, Phi 0.50, 5.9 ns; Y crystal: 529 nm, Phi 0.37, 5.8 ns. Ethanol instead gives normal 373 nm emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Table combines earlier and newly obtained measurements as stated by authors. Solvent and state conditions differ.

reference_evidence_units.quote: it is unlikely that the specific mode of molecular packing is required
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Amorphous solid; 0.5 wt% PMMA; dilute THF 1e-5 M frozen at 77 K.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Bright emission in amorphous powder, polymer matrix and frozen solution supports conformational fixation rather than a unique crystal arrangement as the main enhancement factor.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Controls constrain the interpretation but do not directly measure excited-state torsional distributions.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The coplanar S1- keto form was more stable (by 32.5 kJ·mol−1)
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: MS-CASPT2 with CASSCF geometries; no solvent included (p.2).
reference_evidence_units.statement: Computed keto S1 stabilization relative to enol supports ESIPT; emission energies 2.29 eV keto and 3.46 eV enol are compared with solution bands.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Electronic energies are calculated, not measured reaction rates; solvent omitted and active spaces finite.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the corresponding crossing point was found at 90°.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP keto form
reference_evidence_units.statement: Keto S0-S1 gap becomes small near 60 degrees and crosses near 90 degrees; authors associate torsion-accessible CI with weak solution fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: This is the constrained scan, not the fully relaxed minimal-basis result; do not conflate the two angles.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The intersection point between the S0 and S1 states was found at the torsion angle of 60°
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP keto form
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Fully relaxed CASSCF(6,6)/ANO-S-MB exploration, continued from p.5.
reference_evidence_units.statement: A relaxed pathway locates an intersection around 60 degrees, about 19 kJ/mol downhill from the keto S1 minimum at 37.7 degrees.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Method differs from the constrained 90-degree crossing. The paper does not supply measured CI crossing dynamics.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Suppression of the efficient radiationless decay process via the S0/S1 CI allows emissive decay
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Crystals with torsions below 6 degrees, frozen solution and polymer matrix.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Fixing a nearly planar geometry is proposed to prevent twisting toward CI and permit nanosecond keto S1 fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: RIM, environmental confinement and CI restriction describe overlapping levels of this same proposed pathway.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the S1-keto state can be regarded as an energy trap to inhibit exciton migration.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP crystals
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Antiparallel stacked crystal pairs, approximately 3.4 angstrom spacing.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The low keto S1 energy and distinct keto/enol electronic structures are proposed to inhibit migration and excimer formation despite close stacking.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: An energetic rationale, not direct proof that all intermolecular coupling vanishes; similar solid/matrix photophysics is supporting evidence.

reference_evidence_units.quote: no phosphorescence was observed in the solid state or frozen solution at 77 K
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Solid and frozen solution at 77 K.
reference_evidence_units.statement: No phosphorescence is reported; authors assign the proximity n-pi*/pi-pi* effect a minor role.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: A non-detection does not exclude every triplet population or arbitrarily weak phosphorescence.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the fluorescence color difference between the two crystal polymorphs
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP BG and Y crystals
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Comparison of experimental BG/Y energies with CASSCF, MS-CASPT2 and EOM-CCSD; Table 8 on p.6.
reference_evidence_units.statement: The calculations fail to reproduce the BG/Y color difference satisfactorily; larger calculations and environmental effects remain open.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: CI-based enhancement must not be represented as a solved quantitative model of polymorph color.

reference_evidence_units.quote: no drastic change in the dipole moment was observed upon the S1 or the S2 excitations.
reference_evidence_units.subject: HPIP enol; keto comparison
reference_evidence_units.statement: Enol excitation shows limited net CT; keto excitation involves intramolecular redistribution from phenol toward imidazopyridine.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Electronic redistribution is embedded in tautomer photophysics, not a separately established PET turn-on mechanism.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Restricted central-bond twisting is the general motion description of the CI-access pathway, not an independent second cause.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Crystal, polymer and frozen-solvent confinement enable fixation; unique crystal packing is not necessary.

reference_mechanisms.label: ESIPT_PT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Keto-state emission and ESIPT energy trapping are explicit source-supported parts of the mechanism.

reference_mechanisms.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Direct source calculations and interpretation support torsion-mediated CI decay suppressed by near-planar fixation, with method-dependent CI geometry retained.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Restricted central-bond twisting is the general motion description of the CI-access pathway, not an independent second cause.

mechanism_decisions.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Crystal, polymer and frozen-solvent confinement enable fixation; unique crystal packing is not necessary.

mechanism_decisions.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No host or analyte binding mechanism changing target emission is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Retain calculated redistribution, but no separate CT-controlled enhancement or TICT mechanism is established beyond ESIPT.

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Keto-state emission and ESIPT energy trapping are explicit source-supported parts of the mechanism.

mechanism_decisions.label: PET_ET
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific photoinduced electron-transfer pathway is established in this extraction.

mechanism_decisions.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: An excimer-emission explanation is disfavored: authors propose suppression of excimer formation and migration, not an emissive excimer. This is bounded to the studied crystals.

mechanism_decisions.label: RADIATIVE_RATE_STATE_BALANCE
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No distinct radiative-rate or state-population explanation is established; intensity or lifetime changes alone do not isolate it.

mechanism_decisions.label: TRIPLET_METAL_ENERGY_TRANSFER
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No phosphorescence observed even at 77 K; no positive triplet contribution established, without claiming absolute triplet exclusion.

mechanism_decisions.label: RACI_CI_ACCESS
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Direct source calculations and interpretation support torsion-mediated CI decay suppressed by near-planar fixation, with method-dependent CI geometry retained.

mechanism_decisions.label: SOKR_ANTI_KASHA
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No higher-state emission or anti-Kasha mechanism is established in this extraction.
